verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26657053 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318746 (dated 2026-09-25). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, qty 5,500 at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-10-30. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The document has no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: the document says EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed', yet says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally bears these costs, so the buyer should confirm who pays and whether the invoice will carry these charges.
The confirmed quantity (5,500) is not compared with the PO quantity because the PO is not part of this document.
The document has no issue date of its own. It gives only the customer order date, 2026-09-25.
observations: Single-page, clean printed document. It has no stamps, signatures or handwriting.
The unit price is shown without a total line value.
The quantity 5,500 uses a comma as the thousands separator, as in English.
